npcs.name: Maro
npcs.title: stranded swordsman
npcs.greeting: A living face at last! I am Maro, once of the eastern guard. Something dragged my company down; only I crawled back out.
npcs.returnGreeting: Still breathing, friend? Good. These depths have taken enough.

topics.response: The silver key lies east, past the twisting halls. The ward on the northern door will yield to it.
…so the whispers reach even this floor? Pray you never meet the boy they talk about.

npcs.name: Voss
npcs.title: iron-nosed sentinel
npcs.greeting: I lost my nose to a trap and my patience to tourists. State your business.
npcs.returnGreeting: Still here? The silver key is east. I would not dawdle.

topics.response: East. Far east. Past the pit. The chest is guarded by nothing but your cowardice.

npcs.name: The Cauldron
npcs.title: laughing shrine
npcs.greeting: HA! Another meal strolls in! …Kidding. Mostly. I am a kettle that learned to talk. Ask away.
npcs.returnGreeting: Back for stew? There is none. There was never any.

topics.response: Southwest branch. Bronze, brass, whatever — the lock hunger is the same.

npcs.name: The Shackled Colossus
npcs.title: chained giant
npcs.greeting: Chains rattle. The giant does not look up.

topics.response: No key fits these shackles. Only blood.

npcs.name: The Lowing Saint
npcs.greeting: Moo, says the saint. Moo, say the stones.

events.message: A circular recess waits for a warden sphere. Yours is empty-handed.
A slot for gate-tokens. Rust has welded it shut.
A sealed arch. Nothing on the other side answers.
The floor gives way into a pit. You catch the lip — barely.
The chute drops into darkness. Not today.
The walls repeat your footsteps a half-beat late — as if someone else walked here first.
The walls repeat your footsteps a half-beat late — as if someone else walked here first.
A pit trap! Spikes graze your legs.
